title: Lithium-metal all-solid-state batteries enabled by polymer-coated halide solid electrolytes

authors.name: Pravin N. Didwal

abstract: <jats:p>Polymer coating on a halide-solid-electrolyte markedly enhances air and chemical stabilities and suppresses interfacial decomposition at the lithium metal anode.</jats:p>
